title: i18n: TranslationBundle has no surface for screen-flow UI — wizard screens render source-language only, even in a fully localized app
body:
## Context

HotCRM (main `333259a4`, @objectstack 17.0.0-rc.5) completed all four locales and retired its i18n exemption ledger (hotcrm#645/#679). Yet its lead-conversion wizard (`lead_conversion`, `type: 'screen'`) renders entirely in English on a zh-CN console:

- screen title: **Conversion Details**
- field labels: **Create Opportunity? / Opportunity Name / Opportunity Amount**
- runner buttons: **Cancel / Submit**

## Root cause

The TranslationBundle schema (`@objectstack/spec` `translation.zod`) exposes surfaces for **objects, apps, dashboards, actions** — there is **no `flows` / screen surface at all**. An app author has no place to put translations for screen titles or screen field labels: this is not a missing key, it is a missing vocabulary.

```
$ grep -oE '(flows?|screens?|apps|objects|views|dashboards|actions)[?:]' translation.zod-*.d.ts | sort | uniq -c
  6 actions:   4 apps:   3 dashboards:   4 objects:   # no flows, no screens
```

## Expected

A `flows` surface in the bundle (per-flow: label, per-screen: title, per-field: label/placeholder/help), applied by the screen-flow runner the same way object/field labels already are. The runner chrome (Cancel/Submit) presumably belongs to the console's own message catalog instead.

## Repro

zh-CN console → HotCRM → any lead → 转化线索 → wizard is English top to bottom.

Filed from HotCRM main; happy to wire the HotCRM-side bundle entries as soon as the surface exists.
